title: Programledare & Strategisk Rådgivare inom SAP Transformation
description:
***Vill du leda affärskritiska SAP-transformationer och hjälpa kunder att lyckas med sina viktigaste förändringsinitiativ?***


Vi utvecklar nu vårt affärsområde Business Transformation och söker dig som vill leda några av våra mest strategiska SAP-transformationer.


Hos oss arbetar du nära kundernas ledning, verksamhet och projektorganisation för att omsätta strategi till konkreta resultat och långsiktig förändring. Vi hjälper både midmarket- och enterprisekunder genom hela transformationsresan, från målbild till realiserad affärsnytta.

**Om rollen**


Som Programledare inom SAP Transformation leder du komplexa transformationsprogram, SAP S/4HANA-implementationer och andra strategiska förändringsinitiativ hos våra kunder.


Du ansvarar för att skapa struktur, framdrift och samsyn i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter och parallella leveransspår. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med ledning, styrgrupper, verksamhet och IT där du kombinerar programledning och förändringsledning med strategisk rådgivning.


Genom att förstå kundens affär, bygga starka relationer och identifiera nya möjligheter hjälper du kunden att skapa långsiktigt värde och nå sina mål.

**Vi letar efter dig som**

* Har minst 10 års erfarenhet av att leda SAP-projekt, transformationsprogram eller större förändringsinitiativ.
* Har god förståelse för SAP och hur teknik, verksamhet och förändring samverkar för att skapa affärsvärde.
* Är van att arbeta nära ledningsgrupper, styrgrupper och andra seniora beslutsfattare.
* Bygger förtroendefulla relationer och navigerar tryggt i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter.
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
**Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA-transformationer.
* Erfarenhet av RISE with SAP och/eller GROW with SAP.
* Erfarenhet från konsultverksamhet eller större transformationsinitiativ på verksamhetssidan.
* Erfarenhet från exempelvis tillverkande industri, retail eller energisektorn.
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla kundrelationer och identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter i befintliga kundengagemang.

**För att lyckas hos oss**


Vi tror att du är en person som skapar förtroende och bygger starka relationer på alla nivåer i en organisation.


Du kombinerar ett strategiskt perspektiv med ett pragmatiskt arbetssätt och har förmågan att skapa struktur, riktning och framdrift i komplexa sammanhang. Du är kommunikativ och trygg i dialogen med både verksamhet, IT och ledning.


Samtidigt är du drivande och ansvarstagande, tar initiativ när det behövs och får människor att samlas kring gemensamma mål. Vi värdesätter också ett coachande och prestigelöst förhållningssätt där du gärna delar med dig av kunskap och bidrar till teamets utveckling.

**Därför väljer du Implema**


Hos oss får du möjlighet att:

* Leda komplexa transformationsinitiativ hos både midmarket- och enterprisekunder.
* Arbeta nära kundernas ledning, styrgrupper och verksamhet.
* Samarbeta med några av marknadens mest erfarna SAP-specialister.
* Arbeta i transformationsprojekt inom både SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud (RISE) och Public Cloud (GROW).
* Stort mandat, korta beslutsvägar och möjlighet att göra skillnad för både kund och internt inom vårt affärsområde.


Vår styrka är den unika bredden i gränslandet mellan strategi, verksamhetsutveckling, förändringsledning och SAP. Här får du möjlighet att hjälpa kunder genom hela transformationsresan, från målbild och vägval till genomförande och realiserad affärsnytta.


Vi tror på ett arbetsklimat där kunskap delas, initiativ uppmuntras och människor utvecklas tillsammans. För oss är det viktigt med work-life balance och en arbetsmiljö där människor trivs, stannar länge och har roligt tillsammans.

**Ansökan**

* *Låter detta som något som tilltalar dig? Då hoppas vi att du vill bli en del av vårt team.*

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så vänta inte med din ansökan.


Har du frågor om rollen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Caroline Dajén , rekryteringsansvarig eller vice affärsområdeschef, Carina Segersten.

title: Senior Lönespecialist & Team Lead till Tre
description:
* Ansök senast: 20 december 2026
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Vi på Tre vill skapa en modern, effektiv och framtidssäkrad lönefunktion där hög kvalitet, smarta arbetssätt och en stark medarbetarupplevelse går hand i hand.


Nu söker vi en **Senior Lönespecialist & Team Lead** som vill kombinera operativ lönehantering med ansvar för att leda, samordna och utveckla det dagliga arbetet inom Payroll.


Det här är en nyckelroll för dig som drivs av att säkerställa en löneleverans med hög kvalitet samtidigt som du aktivt förbättrar arbetssätt, processer och system. Du är inte nöjd med att göra saker på samma sätt bara för att de alltid har gjorts så, utan motiveras av att hitta smartare och mer effektiva lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för verksamheten.  

  

**Om rollen**  

Som Senior Lönespecialist & Team Lead ansvarar du tillsammans med teamet för löneleveransen till cirka 1 200 medarbetare på Tre.


Rollen kombinerar kvalificerat lönearbete med ansvar för att planera, prioritera och samordna det dagliga arbetet inom Payroll. Rollen har inget personalansvar men ett tydligt Team Lead-ansvar för leveransen, samarbetet och utvecklingen inom området.


Du blir en del av ett Payroll-team bestående av erfarna och engagerade kollegor där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och hög servicenivå är en naturlig del av vardagen.


Du arbetar nära HR, Finance, chefer, medarbetare och externa leverantörer och blir en viktig expert och rådgivare inom löneområdet.


Rollen innebär också ett tydligt ansvar för att identifiera och driva förbättringar inom Payroll. En viktig del av uppdraget är att utveckla arbetssätt, minska manuella moment, stärka kvaliteten och bidra till en mer effektiv och hållbar leverans över tid.
  

  

**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**

* Leda, planera och koordinera det dagliga arbetet inom Payroll-teamet
* Säkerställa korrekta och kvalitetssäkrade lönekörningar
* Hantera komplexa lönefrågor kopplade till exempelvis bonusar, provisioner och förmåner
* Stötta teamet samt ge rådgivning till chefer och medarbetare inom lön och regelverk
* Säkerställa efterlevnad av lagar, kollektivavtal och interna riktlinjer
* Arbeta med rapportering, analyser och kvalitetsuppföljning
* Identifiera, prioritera och driva förbättringsinitiativ inom Payroll med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet och minskad administration
* Säkerställa att förbättringsinitiativ omsätts från idé till implementerad lösning
* Fungera som kravställare och sakkunnig i utveckling av Payroll-processer, system och digitala arbetssätt
* Samverka med externa leverantörer och andra interna funktioner


Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett starkt fokus på leverans med en dokumenterad förmåga att skapa förbättringar. Förbättringsarbetet är inte något som sker när tid finns över, utan en naturlig del av rollen och något vi förväntar oss att du driver aktivt tillsammans med teamet och verksamheten.

**Vad vi hoppas att du har åstadkommit efter ditt första år:**

* Bidragit till en fortsatt stabil och kvalitetssäkrad löneleverans för cirka 1 200 medarbetare
* Etablerat dig som en naturlig samordnare och expert inom Payroll-teamet
* Drivit förbättringsinitiativ som minskat administration, effektiviserat arbetssätt och stärkt kvaliteten i löneleveransen
* Byggt starka samarbeten med HR, Finance och våra externa partners
* Bidragit till utvecklingen av digitala lösningar och smartare arbetssätt inom Payroll

**Sebastian beskriver sitt ledarskap**
  

"Jag tror på att ge människor stort ansvar och mandat inom sina områden. För mig handlar ledarskap om tillit, tydlighet och att skapa rätt förutsättningar för hög kvalitet i leveransen. Jag uppskattar personer som både tar ansvar för det dagliga arbetet och samtidigt driver förbättringar som gör verksamheten bättre över tid. Hos mig får du stort förtroende, men också möjlighet att påverka hur vi utvecklar Payroll framåt."

**Du kan se fram emot att:**

* Kombinera specialistkompetens inom lön med ett tydligt Team Lead-ansvar
* Få mandat att påverka och utveckla Payrolls arbetssätt och processer
* Arbeta nära verksamheten och bygga breda kontaktnät inom organisationen
* Driva konkreta förbättringsinitiativ som ger synliga resultat
* Vara med och utveckla hur HR Services arbetar med digitala lösningar, automation och självservice
* Tillhöra ett kompetent och engagerat team på en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place to Work


**Några av våra medarbetare**
-----------------------------

Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
*"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."*
Henrik Sundvall
Digital projektledare
*"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"*
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Mer om dig**  

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren lönespecialist som trivs med att ta ansvar och skapa struktur. Du känner dig trygg i komplexa lönefrågor och har sannolikt erfarenhet av att samordna eller leda arbete i team, formellt eller informellt.


Du behöver inte ha haft personalansvar tidigare, men du trivs i en roll där du samordnar, prioriterar och skapar förutsättningar för att teamet ska lyckas.


Du är tydlig, serviceinriktad och pedagogisk i din kommunikation. Samtidigt har du integritet och vågar fatta beslut när situationen kräver det. Du trivs med att kombinera strategiskt förbättringsarbete med att själv vara nära den dagliga löneleveransen.


Framför allt söker vi dig som har visat att du kan identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätta dem till konkreta resultat. Kanske har du effektiviserat en process, minskat manuellt arbete, stärkt kvaliteten, infört nya arbetssätt eller drivit förändringar som gjort vardagen enklare för både kollegor och verksamhet.

**Vi tror att du har:**

* Flera års erfarenhet av kvalificerat lönearbete
* Erfarenhet av att självständigt driva löneprocesser och lönekörningar
* God kunskap inom svensk lönehantering, skatt, pensioner och förmåner
* Erfarenhet av att koordinera eller leda arbete i team
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att driva och genomföra förbättringsinitiativ inom lön, administration eller närliggande områden
* God systemvana och mycket goda kunskaper i Excel
* Förmåga att prioritera och skapa struktur i en verksamhet med många kontaktytor
* Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska

**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:**

* Hogia
* Systemförvaltning eller systemrelaterat förbättringsarbete
* Processutveckling och effektiviseringsinitiativ
* Automatiseringsinitiativ eller förbättringsprojekt som lett till effektivare arbetssätt eller ökad kvalitet
* Större organisationer med komplex lönehantering


Som person är du ansvarstagande, lösningsorienterad och trygg i din kompetens. Du bygger förtroende genom hög kvalitet, gott samarbete och ett genuint engagemang för både verksamheten och människorna omkring dig.


Du kombinerar ett starkt leveransfokus med en vilja att hela tiden göra saker lite bättre än igår.

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**


Vi tar emot ansökningar via den här annonsen och går igenom dem löpande. Du behöver inte skicka med ett personligt brev, bifoga ditt CV och besvara frågorna i samband med din ansökan.

**Så här ser vägen till Tre ut:** Vi börjar med ett urval, följt av tester och en kortare telefonintervju. Därefter får du träffa den rekryterande chefen i en första intervju, följt av en kompetensbaserad intervju med vår Talent Acquisition Partner. För slutkandidaten ingår även referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll.


Vi använder tester som en del av urvalet för att skapa en så objektiv och rättvis bedömning som möjligt. Vi intervjuar löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan, tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.


**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* Friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrarlön, pension & försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
* Flexibla helgdagar och sex dagar extra ledigt per år
* Hundzon & gym i 3huset
* Subventionerad lunch
* Förmånliga rabatter på cyklar, kollektivtrafik och elbilar
* Generösa bonusmodeller eller provisioner
**Om företaget**
----------------

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.


Tre föddes som utmanare och är en organisation i ständig rörelse. Vi strävar efter att vara i framkant i allt vi gör. Vi är övertygade om att det är människorna och kulturen på Tre som är avgörande för vår utveckling.


När du startar din resa på Tre finns det oändliga möjligheter att växa och utvecklas med oss.

**WE THINK LIKE CHALLENGERS** - I en föränderlig värld, är vi på Tre nyfikna och ständigt öppna för nya lösningar. På Tre anpassar vi vägen framåt allt eftersom vi provar och lär oss vad som funkar bäst.

**WE WORK LIKE CHAMPIONS** - På Tre gör vi alltid vårt bästa. Vi känner ägandeskap för vår uppgift, sätter tydliga mål och håller fokus på det som gör mest nytta för affären.

 **WE ACT LIKE BUDDIES** - På Tre är vi schyssta kollegor. Vi samarbetar med varandra över team och funktioner, vi bollar idéer, ger och tar emot feedback.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
We're hiring an Applied AI Engineer to join our engineering team. You'll help turn licensed data into AI-ready data, working on processing, quality, and enrichment at scale. It's a hands-on role where you'll work closely with our CPTO and fellow engineers.


Redpine is the knowledge layer for agentic AI, unlocking access to licensed premium, non-public data in health, science, finance, and physical AI. We work with some of the world's largest AI companies, and we've raised $9.4M from VCs and founders and leaders at OpenAI, Perplexity, Spotify, Sana, and SiloAI.

**What you'll do**

* Build and ship AI features end to end, from first prototype to production
* Develop pipelines that ingest, process, and structure licensed content from our data partners
* Apply LLMs and agents to data quality, validation, and enrichment across text, images, and other formats
* Build the evals that tell us when output is right, and catch it when it stops being right
* Work with product and commercial to turn real customer use cases into what we build next

**Who you are**

* 3+ years building and shipping production software, not prototypes someone else has to finish
* Strong Python and backend fundamentals, with experience running large-scale data pipelines in the cloud
* Real depth with LLM systems: agents, retrieval, tool use, and evals. You know where they break, and when a simpler approach does the job better
* AI-native: coding agents do most of your typing. You know how to brief them, check their work, and stand behind what ships
* Ownership by default. You take a broad goal, work out what it requires, and say so when the spec is wrong
* A track record of high ambition and figuring things out, with a bias for action

**Why Redpine**  

Access to quality data is one of the biggest bottlenecks in advancing AI where it matters most, from drug discovery to robotics. The company that builds the licensed layer underneath will define the next decade. Redpine will be that company. Joining now means ownership and impact from day one, working alongside a diverse core team from McKinsey, VC, Spotify, Sana, Zettle, Deloitte and more.


The pace is high and so is the bar. We offer competitive salary, meaningful equity, and benefits. We're English-first and office-first in a beautiful space in central Stockholm. We hire for talent, drive, and attitude over a perfect CV. If this excites you, apply.

title: Head Of Project Controls
description:
Role overview We are looking for an experienced Head of Project Controls to lead Stegra’s Central Project Controls team on the Boden Project. The role sets the controls strategy, standards and governance for planning, cost, estimating, change, risk and reporting, and makes sure they are applied consistently across Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant. The Head of Project Controls will be the senior controls voice to project leadership, giving an honest and integrated view of time and cost performance, and making sure emerging threats are visible early enough for leadership to act. Reporting line and team structure The Central Project Controls team sets the standards, processes and governance for project controls and delivers into each of the project areas (Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant).
  
  

Reports to the Chief Finance Officer, Stegra Boden Project. Leads the Central Project Controls team, including cost, planning, estimating, change and reporting, and sets the standards to which the Area Project Controls Managers work. Key responsibilities Lead the Central Project Controls team and set the controls strategy, organisation and resourcing plan for the project. Define and own the project controls procedures, standards, WBS and coding structures, and governance that apply across all project areas.
  
  

Ensure central standards are applied consistently in every project area, so that cost, schedule, change and risk data can be integrated and compared across Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant. Own the integrated scope, cost and schedule baseline for the project, and the process for controlling it. Provide integrated cost and schedule performance, forecasts and risk exposure to project leadership, executives and the board, with clear messages and the decisions required. Lead the monthly project controls cycle and challenge forecasts, progress and performance data that are not credible or not supported by evidence.
  
  

Oversee earned value management and progress measurement across the project areas and EPCM contractors. Set the direction for project controls systems and data, including Primavera P6, Contruent, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Power BI, working with Stegra’s systems and data architecture teams. Ensure estimating, change control and risk management are fully integrated with cost and schedule control. Set the project controls requirements for EPCM contractors and hold them to account for the quality and timeliness of their data.
  
  

Support funding and investment decisions with robust cost, schedule and cash-flow forecasts. Build, mentor and develop the central team and the wider project controls community across the project. Required experience and skills Minimum 15 years’ project controls experience on major capital projects, including at least 5 years leading a multidisciplinary project controls function. Proven experience leading project controls in an EPCM or owner’s team environment on a major project or programme.
  
  

Deep understanding of planning and scheduling, cost control, estimating, change control, risk management, earned value and reporting, and how they fit together. A track record of setting up project controls functions, procedures and governance, ideally on a greenfield project. Experience presenting to executives, boards, lenders or investors. Strong leadership and stakeholder management, with the confidence to challenge senior leaders and contractors.
  
  

Familiarity with Primavera P6, Contruent or similar cost management systems, and Power BI. Experience in steel, metals, heavy industrial, energy or process plant projects would be beneficial. Relevant degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying or a related discipline. AACE, APM, PMI or equivalent professional accreditation would be advantageous.
  
  

Key expectations The successful candidate will give Stegra one integrated and trusted view of project performance, built on consistent standards across every project area. They will lead with integrity, challenge with evidence, and make sure leadership has the insight it needs to deliver the project safely and successfully against its time, cost and quality objectives.

title: Central Change Manager
description:
Role overview We are looking for an experienced Central Change Manager to run the central change process for the Stegra Boden Project. Working within Central Project Controls under the Central Change Lead, the role manages the change process day to day, maintains the project-wide change register and supports the change governance forums. The role works alongside the Change Managers deployed into the project areas, making sure changes from Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant are assessed and decided consistently, and that the project-wide change position is accurate and visible. Reporting line and team structure These roles form an extension of Stegra’s Central Project Controls team, delivering into each of the project areas (Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant) while working to central standards, processes and governance.
  
  

Reports to the Central Change Lead, Central Project Controls. Key responsibilities Administer the central change process, from receipt of change requests through assessment, approval and implementation. Maintain the project-wide change register, trend log and early warning register, consolidating inputs from all project areas. Check that change submissions are complete, consistent and supported by robust estimates and schedule impact assessments before they go to review boards.
  
  

Organise and support the change control board and other change governance forums, including agendas, papers, decisions and actions. Track approved changes through to implementation, so that budgets, forecasts, contingency, ETC, EAC and the schedule baseline are updated. Maintain and improve change control procedures, templates and guidance under the direction of the Central Change Lead. Report project-wide change status, trends, exposure and pending decisions to the Central Change Lead and project leadership.
  
  

Support the area Change Managers with guidance, quality checks and training on the change process. Work with commercial and contracts teams on contractual entitlement, variations and claims. Maintain change records and supporting documentation in Autodesk Construction Cloud and the cost management system. Analyse change data across the project to identify recurring change drivers and recommend actions to reduce change exposure.
  
  

Required experience and skills Minimum 10 years’ project controls, cost or commercial experience on major capital projects, including significant experience managing change. Proven experience running a central change process and change control board on a major project or programme. Strong cost management capability combined with experience assessing changes, validating cost and schedule impacts and maintaining change registers. Good understanding of contract types, variation mechanisms and claims.
  
  

Experience with Contruent or similar cost management systems, and with Autodesk Construction Cloud, would be an asset. Exceptional attention to detail and strong stakeholder management, with the confidence to challenge project areas and contractors. Experience in steel, metals, heavy industrial, energy or process plant projects would be beneficial. Key expectations The successful candidate will run a central change process that is consistent, timely and well governed, and will give leadership an accurate, project-wide view of change exposure early enough to inform decisions.

title: Change Manager
description:
Role overview We are looking for experienced Change Managers to support baselining and change control across the Stegra Boden Project. Change Managers report directly to the Central Change Lead within Central Project Controls and are deployed to support the project areas. The role helps each project area establish and maintain a robust baseline, so the area can control its scope, cost and schedule, and then pass changes through the central change process when and where required. Change Managers ensure cost and schedule impacts are properly evaluated, governed and recorded.
  
  

Reporting line and team structure These roles form an extension of Stegra’s Central Project Controls team, delivering into each of the project areas (Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant) while working to central standards, processes and governance. Reports to Central Change Lead, Central Project Controls. Key responsibilities Support the project areas in establishing, validating and maintaining their scope, cost and schedule baselines. Help the project areas understand their baselines so they can control delivery and recognise when a change has occurred.
  
  

Guide the project areas through the central change process when and where change is required, from identification through assessment, approval and implementation. Apply the change control procedures and governance set by the Central Change Lead consistently across all project areas. Maintain change registers, trend logs and early warning registers for the project areas supported. Assess and progress change requests, variations and contractor claims, validating scope, cost and schedule impacts.
  
  

Work with estimators to ensure change estimates are robust, traceable and supported by evidence. Work with planners to assess schedule impacts and integrate approved changes into the schedule baseline. Ensure approved changes are reflected in budgets, forecasts, ETC and EAC. Prepare change submissions for review boards and support approval processes.
  
  

Report change status, trends, exposure and pending decisions to the Central Change Lead and project leadership. Work with commercial and contracts teams on contractual entitlement and change mechanisms. Maintain change records and supporting documentation in Autodesk Construction Cloud and the cost management system. Identify recurring change drivers and recommend actions to reduce change exposure.
  
  

Required experience and skills Minimum 10 years’ project controls, cost or commercial experience on major capital projects, including significant experience managing change. Proven experience establishing and maintaining scope, cost and schedule baselines on major projects. Strong cost management capability combined with experience assessing and progressing changes, validating cost impacts, maintaining change registers and supporting governance and approval processes. Good understanding of contract types, variation mechanisms and claims.
  
  

Experience with Contruent or similar cost management systems, and with Autodesk Construction Cloud, would be an asset. Strong stakeholder management and the ability to challenge contractors and internal teams with confidence. Experience in steel, metals, heavy industrial, energy or process plant projects would be beneficial. Site attendance requirements An on-site presence in Boden, Sweden, five days per week is preferred.
  
  

Candidates seeking a rotational working pattern, or travelling regularly from a nearby location such as (but not limited to) Stockholm, will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Regular site attendance and direct engagement with project and construction teams are expected. Right to work and engagement Contractors must hold the right to work in Sweden. For UK-based permanent candidates, Movar Reply will apply for the required Swedish work permit.
  
  

Contractors must operate and invoice through their own Swedish limited company (Aktiebolag, AB) approved for F-tax (F-skatt). The contractor’s company is solely responsible for managing its own tax affairs and meeting all requirements under Swedish tax law. Permanent (fixed-term employment) roles are open to UK-based candidates only and are not our preferred route. They will be considered only in exceptional circumstances and, where agreed, will be offered as a fixed-term employment contract of a minimum of one year.
  
  

Key expectations The successful candidates will give each project area a baseline it can control against, and will ensure every change is assessed, governed and recorded properly through the central process, so that cost and schedule impacts are visible to leadership early enough to inform decisions.

title: Student in AI: RAG for MAX IV data (part-time, temporary)
description:
Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset.

### **Your team**


At MAX IV, the Technical Division builds and supports the technologies that enable cutting-edge research, while continuously improving how the facility operates. Within this division, the Software team develops and maintains the control systems, data acquisition software, and user interfaces that researchers rely on every day. We focus on increasing functionality and reliability across the facility to meet the demands of world-class science. We provide laboratory wide software solutions following international standards in synchrotrons, such as data acquisition, control system, web-based user interfaces, distributed hardware control, scanning tools for running experiments, and metadata harvesting, to meet the continuously evolving research requirements.


You will join an open and friendly team of 25 developers with diverse backgrounds. Continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and mentorship are central to how we work. We follow a collaborative DevOps approach, where team members support each other and take shared responsibility for our software and infrastructure.

***Would you like to work at one of the brightest light sources in the world?***

**MAX IV is looking for** a motivated master's student in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Language Technology, Large Language Models (LLMs), or a related field.

This is a part-time position (30%) for 8 months### **Your main work tasks will be**

* Developing AI solution that query MAXIV databases and text repositories to answer typed user questions.
* Participate in evaluation of other facilities solutions solving the same problem.
* Participate in any collaboration that MAX IV enters with another facility solving the same problem.

### **To be successful in this role you need to have the following qualifications**

* You are currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree programme, or equivalent education, in a field relevant to the position.
* You have successfully completed at least 60 hp (ECTS) within your current degree programme.
* You have at least 2 years Python programming experience.
* You are solution-focused and have a curious mind with a willingness to explore different approaches.
* You have a good command of English, both spoken and written.

### **Below are seen as merits**

* Documented experience with artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and data analytics, including technologies and frameworks such as Llama, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and cloud-based AI platforms.
* Documented language experience.
* Experience in working in JupyterHUB.
* Experience of JSON files
* The ongoing master diploma work is on the same or similar topic so that synergy effects exists.

**As a person you are** first and foremost a team player and can demonstrate your communication and collaborative skills. You are open to peer review and willing to share your own knowledge. We expect you to be service minded and have the capability to support a user environment that is under continuous development, with a strong focus on maintaining reliability.

### **What we offer**


When you join the MAX IV team, you step into a world of front edge science. We make the invisible visible by supporting scientists from all over the world, generating scientific results for the benefit of society. We offer you a multicultural work environment with great opportunities for personal development with respect for a healthy work-life balance.

#### **For more information, please visit:**


https://www.lunduniversity.lu.se/about-lund-university/work-lund-university


https://www.maxiv.lu.se/about-us/careers/compensation-benefits/

  

MAX IV is a Swedish national large-scale research infrastructure hosted by Lund University. It provides scientists from Sweden and abroad, with intense x-rays and state-of-the-art instrumentation for research in areas such as engineering, physics, structural biology, chemistry and nanotechnology. Its 16 beamlines receive up to 2 000 scientists annually, conducting ground-breaking experiments in materials and life sciences using the brilliant X-rays.


The ICT teams at MAX IV are placed under the Technical Division and deliver solutions to the whole MAX IV organisation in the areas of electronics, software, infrastructure and scientific data. This is a dynamic and highly challenging environment and requires close collaboration with the beamline staff in order to understand the needs and be effective in forming solutions. We are around 50 people in total who work in 4 domains in a well-organised and agile way. We hold values of lean management, knowledge spread, user autonomy, continuous improvement and flexibility as guiding principles for our work.


We kindly decline all sales and marketing contacts.

title: Grafisk Designer till längre konsultuppdrag
description:
Vi söker nu en erfaren Grafisk Designer till ett längre konsultuppdrag hos en av våra kunder. Du blir en del av ett marknadsteam och arbetar brett med grafisk produktion och visuell kommunikation för olika kanaler, målgrupper och aktiviteter.


Rollen passar dig som tycker om kombinationen av kreativt idéarbete och operativ produktion. En stor del av vardagen handlar om att ta fram, utveckla och anpassa grafiskt material, ibland med korta deadlines och flera parallella leveranser. Samtidigt finns möjlighet att bidra med idéer, nya visuella uttryck och kreativa lösningar tillsammans med övriga i teamet.


Du arbetar nära kollegor inom marknad och kommunikation samt samarbetar vid behov med externa partners.

**Exempel på arbetsuppgifter**

* Grafisk produktion för olika typer av kampanjer och marknadsaktiviteter
* Skapa och anpassa material för digitala och tryckta kanaler
* Ta fram innehåll för sociala medier
* Producera animationer och rörligt innehåll
* Arbeta med bildredigering samt foto- och videoproduktion
* Utveckla visuella koncept och kreativa lösningar tillsammans med marknadsteamet
* Anpassa och uppdatera befintligt material för olika kanaler och format
* Säkerställa hög grafisk kvalitet och ett konsekvent visuellt uttryck

**Om dig och dina erfarenheter**


Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av grafisk produktion och visuell kommunikation i en bred roll där både kreativitet och genomförandeförmåga är viktiga delar av arbetet.


Du är trygg i att självständigt driva grafisk produktion från brief till färdigt material och är van att arbeta med både digitala och tryckta format. Du trivs med att växla mellan olika typer av uppgifter och kan hantera flera parallella leveranser utan att tappa känslan för detaljer, kvalitet och helhet.

**Vi ser gärna att du har:**

* Mycket goda kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud, framför allt InDesign, Illustrator och Photoshop
* Erfarenhet av After Effects, animation och rörligt innehåll
* Erfarenhet av bildredigering samt enklare foto- och videoproduktion
* God förståelse för typografi, layout, färg och bildhantering
* Erfarenhet av att skapa material för både digitala och tryckta kanaler
* Förståelse för målgruppsanpassad och kommersiell kommunikation
* Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta mot korta deadlines


Som person är du nyfiken, prestigelös och lösningsorienterad. Du tar ansvar för dina leveranser och tycker om att komma med egna idéer, samtidigt som du är bekväm med att arbeta utifrån befintliga koncept och visuella riktlinjer. Du uppskattar en vardag där tempot stundtals är högt och där idéer relativt snabbt behöver omsättas till färdig kommunikation.

 **Om uppdraget**


Det här är ett konsultuppdrag via Hammer & Hanborg med omfattning på 80–100 procent. Uppdraget är tänkt att påbörjas omgående och sträcker sig till hösten 2027.


På grund av uppdragets karaktär håller vi i det här skedet information om uppdragsgivaren konfidentiell. Du som går vidare i processen får självklart mer information om verksamheten och uppdragets sammanhang.

**Ansökan**  

Ansök genom ”Skicka ansökan-knappen” och svara på ett par frågor. Med hänvisning till GDPR kan ansökningar inte tas emot via e-post. Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

title: Shift Leader Front Office Scandic Göteborg Central, vikariat
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 13 december 2026
* Göteborg
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


Scandic Göteborg Central, beläget i en ny stadsdel som växer fram i den tidigare containerhamnen, alldeles vid brofästet av nya Hisingsbron och ett stenkast från Centralstationen. Hotellet är ett av Scandics största både med sina 451 rum och med en stor mötesavdelning. På hotellet finns lobbybar, café och en härlig Roof Top bar och restaurang med utsikt över Göteborgs hamninlopp. Ett spännande hotell med inspiration från världens alla hörn, där känslan och pulsen från hamnkvarteren och staden utanför tillsammans skapar en levande och personlig atmosfär. Här ges du chansen att vara med och bidra till en arbetsplats i världsklass, där vårt gemensamma mål mot nöjda gäster ger samarbete över gränserna och känslan av Ett hotell.


**Vi söker nu en Shift Leader till vår reception på Scandic Göteborg Central.**


Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Som Shift Leader agerar du värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet för att skapa gästupplevelse i världsklass.


Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd. Teamet utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!


**Vad innebär rollen som Shift Leader Front Office?**


Du som arbetar inom Front Office är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning. Arbetet i Front Office innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet.


I rollen som Shift Leader har du, förutom att vara en del av driften, den övergripande överblicken över gästflödet och ser tillsammans med teamet till att prioritera arbetsuppgifter så att verksamheten flyter så att gästerna blir nöjda. Du leder och fördelar arbetet och hanterar bemanningen under ditt arbetspass. Vid behov får du utbilda nya medarbetare på hotellet och du avlastar också Front Office Manager med vissa administrativa arbetsuppgifter.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Din kompetens**


För den här rollen krävs att du har både förmåga och vilja att arbeta med ett driftsnära ledarskap. Du är trygg i ditt ledarskap och har både integritet och säljdriv. För att passa i rollen tror vi också att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster. Du är en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


**Information om tjänsten:**


Tjänsten är ett vikariat på heltid from 1/2-2027-31/8-2027.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.


Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!


Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Senior Art Director
description:
Natural Cycles is a regulated medical device company that markets like a consumer brand, which is exactly what makes the creative work here harder and better. We are rebuilding the brand to match the science, launching our first wearables, and doing it with a creative team that is being rebuilt at the same time. You are the senior art direction craft in that team: the person who takes a brief and comes back with a point of view, sets the visual bar on the work you touch, and makes the brand hold together across a campaign film, a carousel and a packaging insert. This is a senior individual contributor seat.
  
  

You set the standard through the work rather than through a reporting line. Please note: this role is open only to candidates who already live on the U.S. East Coast or in Stockholm, Sweden. We are not able to offer relocation support.
  
  

What you will be doing Art-direct campaign and brand work from concept to production-ready across film, digital, social, out-of-home, packaging and event. Lead the visual execution of product launches, working from the brand platform rather than restating it each time. Make brand and performance push in the same direction: develop work that holds the brand standard and earns its place in a test. Build systems, not only assets — templates, components, type and grid behaviour, chart and graphic styles that stay coherent as volume grows and more hands touch them.
  
  

**Direct external partners:** photographers, directors, illustrators, retouchers, production and agency teams, and localisation partners adapting work for individual markets. Work with Product Design and Writing so the brand does not change character at the app boundary. Use AI tooling as part of daily production — motion, variation, concepting — and have a view on where it fails. Work inside medical device and advertising constraints, and partner with Regulatory early enough that review is fast rather than adversarial.
  
  

What skills and experience we think you have 8+ years in art direction or design, with a portfolio of integrated work — not a single channel — that performed as well as it looked. Evidence of range: a brand idea carried across formats, from a hero moment down to a paid unit. Systems thinking. Has built templates and components other people actually used.
  
  

Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud; working motion ability, with After Effects or equivalent. Proven quick turnarounds without a drop in craft. Comfort working inside a regulated health brand, including Legal and Regulatory review rounds. Health, wellness or femtech experience is an advantage, as is illustration or 3D for launch moments.
  
  

Currently based on the U.S. East Coast, or in Stockholm, Sweden. What we offer Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team spread across the U.S. East Coast and Sweden that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location Professional development - you will work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in the continuous growth and skill enhancement environment Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development Location We are a remote-friendly company, and we also value connecting in person.
  
  

The team you will be working with are spread across Sweden and the U.S., and for this role we are looking for someone currently based either on the U.S. East Coast, or in Stockholm, Sweden. Salary bracket: $100,000 - $150,000 per year, annual bonus aligned with the Company’s Bonus Policy. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications.
  
  

This range may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will fall toward the starting point of the range, compensation will depend on the candidate's specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role's requirements. title: Senior Cyber Advisor - OT/ICS Security
description:
**Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for Senior Cyber Advisor to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Advisory team.**

##### **About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company**


Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.


Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.


Today, we are around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Senior Cyber Advisor - OT/ICS Security who wants to make a difference in our Advisory Team.

##### **The Advisory Team**


At Truesec, our Advisory team delivers tangible results that strengthen our clients’ cyber resilience. Our advisors are hands-on experts who bridge the gap between strategy and execution, embedding cybersecurity from the C-suite to operational teams. We communicate effectively across all levels, translating complex cyber risks into actionable plans that resonate throughout the organization.


Working alongside cybersecurity specialists, you will help clients turn assessments, strategies, and regulatory requirements into coordinated transformation plans. Your focus will be on governing delivery, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring that recommendations translate into implemented improvements.


Our Advisory team connects executive priorities, regulatory requirements, threat intelligence, architecture, and delivery. We work from assessment and strategy through transformation, implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.

##### **The Role**


As a Senior Cyber Advisor, you will help clients understand cyber risk, make informed investment decisions, and turn priorities into measurable improvements. You will lead strategic assessments and transformation engagements, build trusted senior relationships, and shape opportunities across governance, resilience, architecture, regulation, OT/ICS security, and secure AI adoption.


We are looking for broad strategic cyber-advisory capability combined with demonstrated depth within the OT/ICS security domain.


##### **What you will do:**

* Lead executive discovery, problem framing, strategic assessments, target-state development, and prioritized transformation roadmaps.
* Advise boards, management teams, CISOs, CIOs, engineering leaders, operational leaders, risk functions, legal teams, and technology stakeholders.
* Translate threats, regulatory obligations, business priorities, and capability gaps into clear decisions, investment options, and implementable actions.
* Lead or support assessments using CIS Controls v8.1, NIST CSF 2.0, ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, DORA, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, IEC 62443, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and other relevant frameworks.
* Develop and present findings, recommendations, business cases, roadmaps, metrics, and executive decision material for both technical and business audiences.
* Guide clients beyond assessment by supporting mobilization, implementation, operating-model change, adoption, evidence development, and continuous improvement.
* Shape propositions, scopes, proposals, and presentations; develop existing accounts and identify responsible cross-service opportunities with Truesec colleagues.
* Lead coherent multidisciplinary deliveries involving advisors, architects, incident-response specialists, technology experts, and client teams.

###### **As a Senior Advisor within OT/ICS Security, you will also be doing the following:**

* Assess and improve OT governance, asset visibility, industrial architecture, zones and conduits, segmentation, secure remote access, monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident readiness.
* Advise on IT/OT convergence and coordinate security priorities across engineering, operations, safety, IT, suppliers, and enterprise security.
* Address legacy systems, constrained patching, compensating controls, third-party maintenance, lifecycle risk, and operational continuity.
* Develop OT security target states and prioritized roadmaps aligned to IEC 62443 and the client's threat and business context.
* Integrate OT incident preparedness with enterprise crisis management, business continuity, disaster recovery, and cyber response.
* As a specialist within OT/ICS Security should be able to balance cybersecurity with safety, availability, production continuity, engineering constraints, and operational ownership.

##### **Your Potential Background**


You are a commercially effective trusted advisor who combines sound judgement with practical delivery. You can move between executive priorities and operational realities, and you know when to lead directly and when to bring in specialist expertise.


###### **Required experience and capabilities**

* At least 7 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity consulting, strategic advisory, enterprise security, OT/ICS security, AI governance and security, or a comparable senior role.
* Demonstrated depth in either OT/ICS security or secure AI adoption, with working knowledge of the other domain.
* Experience leading assessments, strategy or transformation engagements and communicating findings to management and C-suite stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of cyber risk management, security architecture, governance, and regulatory implementation.
* Ability to convert client needs into valuable propositions, clear scopes, credible delivery approaches, and long-term trusted relationships.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and ensuring integrated, high-quality deliverables.
* Strong written, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder-engagement skills in Swedish and English.

###### **Additional strengths**

* Experience with product and supply-chain security, vulnerability handling, secure development, third-party assurance, or the EU Cyber Resilience Act.
* Experience with business continuity, crisis management, incident response, identity security, Microsoft security capabilities, cloud security, or security operations.
* Experience mentoring advisors, developing consulting IP, creating thought leadership, or building repeatable advisory services.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer, IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert or Specialist, GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443 certificates, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer, or equivalent credentials.
* An established client network or prior responsibility for commercial targets, proposals, account development, or cross-selling.

***Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.***

##### **Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future**


At Truesec, you will work with experienced cyber specialists and help shape the next generation of Strategic Cyber Advisory. If you combine executive credibility, practical delivery, commercial judgement, and specialist depth in OT/ICS, we would like to hear from you.

**Overview**
------------


### **About us**


We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.


As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.


### **About the role**


*Are you a seasoned penetration tester? Do you want to work in an international environment with some of the best professionals in the industry? We are looking for you to be a part of us!*


**The role in short**


Our team conducts penetration testing, cybersecurity assessments and technical advisory services across IT systems, applications, Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS), supporting clients in critical industries.


This role offers a unique opportunity to work on challenging assignments across IT and OT environments, including maritime systems, energy infrastructure, oil and gas, renewables, utilities and other critical sectors. Technical expertise, creativity and curiosity are highly valued.


The role involves domestic and international travel, including hands-on testing and assessments at industrial sites, vessels, control rooms and critical infrastructure facilities. You should be comfortable travelling, sometimes at short notice, and motivated by working with clients across different countries, cultures and industries.


Based at DNV’s Stockholm office, you will work alongside experienced cybersecurity specialists in a highly technical and collaborative environment. DNV will actively support your professional development through structured competence development plans, certifications and participation in industry-leading projects.


As a Senior Penetration Tester, you will play a key role in identifying vulnerabilities across networks, web and mobile applications, physical devices and cloud environments. This hands-on role requires deep cybersecurity expertise, strong technical skills and the ability to lead and mentor junior colleagues while delivering high-quality services to our clients.


**What you will do:**
  

As an Industrial/Senior Penetration Tester at DNV Cyber, you will contribute to projects such as:


* Penetration testing of IT, OT environments, some of which in live operations
* OT and ICS security assessments and audits in industrial and critical infrastructure environments
* Testing of networks, applications, infrastructure, and industrial systems
* On-site assessments at customer locations in Norway and internationally
* Preparation of high-quality technical reports and executive summaries
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across DNV’s global cyber security organization
* You will have the opportunity to work on technically exciting IT & OT pentesting engagements involving environments such as PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, Mainframe systems, industrial networks, remote access solutions, maritime systems and safety-critical infrastructure as well as standard and custom IT environments and applications.

**Your daily work will include**


* Identify and exploit vulnerabilities in applications and networks
* Document technical issues identified during security Assessments: describe, provide reproduction and remediation steps and classify their severity according to industry standards.
* Research emerging security topics and new attack vectors
* Ensure project deadlines are met and clients are kept up to date on meeting relevant milestones
* Interact with customers in a collaborative, consultative manner to deliver results, provide feedback and remediation

Visit our website to get to know more about us!

* Deep understanding of cyber security and strong technical skills
* Strong understanding of web application security, network security, and operating system security
* Experience with different hacking tools
* Excellent communication and reporting skills in both Swedish and English
* Formal education at minimum BSc level or above in relevant areas such as cyber security, computer science, telecom, automation, cybernetics or similar. Relevant experience may compensate for formal education
* Interest in, or experience with OT and ICS security
* Understanding of network architectures in IT and OT systems
* Good written and spoken communication skills
* A customer-oriented mindset and the ability to build strong relationships with clients and colleagues
* A collaborative attitude and willingness to share knowledge with others
* Personal integrity and professionalism suitable for working with a trust-based brand such as DNV
* A positive, constructive and solution-oriented “can-do” attitude

**It is an advantage if you have one or more of the following:**


* Experience with industrial automation
* Experience with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems and industrial networks
* Experience with OT penetration testing or OT security assessments
* Experience with Active Directory penetration testing
* Prior background from maritime, energy, renewables, utilities or other critical infrastructure sectors
* Knowledge of the IEC 62443 standard
* Cyber security certifications such as GICSP, OSCP, GPEN, CRTP, or other similar certifications
* The ability to obtain security clearance

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*
**Benefits**
------------


Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter.


### **Profit Share**


You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year-end results.


### **Meaningful work**


Work with pioneering customers and talented colleagues on projects that help tackle some of the world's most pressing challenges and contribute to a safer, smarter and greener future.


### **Pension Schemes**


We care about your long-term financial security and prioritize pension and retirement benefits to reflect our caring values.


### **Professional Development**


We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education.


### **Growth and development**


Take ownership of your development through meaningful work, collaboration with experts, mentoring, learning programmes and opportunities to build new skills throughout your career.


### **Purpose-led organization**


You become part of a world-leading company where we know and live our purpose; to safeguard life, property, and the environment, with the opportunity to tackle global change through your work.


### **Supportive and caring culture**


We offer opportunities to connect through social and professional networks. Our largest community CONNECT, organizes after-work events and informal meetings throughout the year.


### **Attractive rewards**


We focus on work/life balance and offer employees flexible working hours and workplace, annual vacation allowance, competitive pension, insurance, and a global profit share scheme.

  

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
-----------------------------------


At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision.


Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values.

Job Summary

Your responsibilities may be focused on payroll and/or customer services and you will be flexible supporting either as or when required
  
  

Key Responsibilities

Liaise and transact with Third Parties.
  
SOC Controls completed on time and with the necessary evidences

Highlight to Service Manager any deviations from the standard scope of service.
  
Ability to recognize and deal appropriately with sensitive and confidential information.
  
Time Recording to be completed accurately and on time.
  
Strada Security Standards are adhered and followed.
  
Contribute to team meetings and raise any issues immediately to your Service Manager.
  
Ensure you are up to date with all Strada HR announcements and communications.
  
Build good relationships with all lines of businesses where appropriate.
  
Update internal stakeholders, when needed, in a timely and accurate way.
  
Participates in projects and activities as needed and assigned.

Experience in Norwegian Payroll administration in an HR Outsourcing, Payroll Services, or Corporate environment.
  
Good understanding of Norwegian payroll legislation, tax regulations, social security requirements, and statutory reporting.
  
Experience processing payroll data, including hires, terminations, absences, benefits, and payroll adjustments.
  
HRIS knowledge such as Workday, SAP, PeopleSoft, or similar payroll/HR systems is preferred.
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  
  

Work Experience
  
  

Experience in a payroll role, preferably supporting Norway payroll processes. Knowledge of absences processing
  
and pension reporting will be a plus.
  
Experience working with HR and payroll data, ensuring accuracy and compliance with local regulations.
  
Strong knowledge of MS Office applications, especially Excel.
  
Ability to manage end-to-end payroll activities and resolve payroll-related queries.
  
Experience supporting statutory reporting and year-end payroll activities is an advantage.
  
Flexibility to work in a fast-paced and international environment.
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
Self-motivated, proactive, and willing to continuously learn and develop payroll expertise.
  
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment and adhering to established processes and procedures.

As an AWS Early Career Talent Commercial Sales Representative, you'll apply your commercial and technical skills to help new and existing customers move faster on their cloud and AI journey, with mentorship and peer support along the way.
  

  

You're a driven self-starter with a strong commercial mindset and a curious, customer-first approach. You thrive on ambitious goals, deliver results by aligning solutions to each customer's business priorities, and are always looking for new ways to grow and make an impact.

* Build and grow relationships with customer stakeholders, up to C-level

title: Functional Advisor
description:
**About Us**


At Medius, we believe managing finance should be about strategy, not stress. That same mindset shapes not only the solutions we build, but also the culture we create for our people. We remove complexity, embrace innovation, and give our teams the freedom to focus on what truly matters — whether that’s transforming the future of finance with AI or finding balance to go home on time.


Founded in Sweden in 2001, Medius has grown from a local startup into a global leader in cloud-based spend management solutions. Today, thousands of organizations worldwide trust us to simplify accounts payable and spend management processes. Our journey has been driven by continuous innovation, a passion for technology, and above all — the people who make it happen.


We’re more than a software company. We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators and collaborators working together to reinvent the category of accounts payable. Our solutions use Artificial Intelligence to eliminate manual work, bring clarity, confidence, and control, and empower finance teams of the future.

**At Medius,** our values guide how we work and grow together:

* **Connect** – We believe in the power of people—individually and collectively—and our success depends on understanding and respecting each other. We appreciate that ‘empowering finance teams of the future’ is an exciting endeavor, and we share it with everyone around us.
* **Question** – We enjoy the challenge of our work and the thrill of collaboration. We are not afraid to question ourselves and each other because we believe diverse perspectives can lead to better outcomes and that there is great power in resolution.
* **Own** – We are thorough, thoughtful, and decisive. We anticipate what’s next, what a customer might need, and then we deliver. That’s how we get things done. And that’s how we remain a leader. Customers trust us to do our job so that they can focus on what they do best.


At Medius, you’ll join a diverse, global community where curiosity is celebrated, ideas matter, and innovation never stops. If you’re passionate about technology, eager to make an impact, and ready to grow alongside a team that lives its values, Medius is where you can do your best work — your impact is global.


Learn more at www.medius.com

**Job overview**


Medius is seeking a Functional Advisor with a focus on Europe engagements to join our growing team.


In this role, you will play a critical part in the Functional and Technical Adoption team within the Customer Success organization. You will partner with some of our most strategic, high-profile customers around the globe, helping them maximize the value of their Medius investment.


As a trusted advisor, you will guide customers through their automation journey—driving adoption, optimizing workflows, and improving efficiency across processes powered by the Medius product suite.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Work closely with our live customers to help them in their efforts to achieve improved processes and increased efficiency
* Analyze customer data to provide suggestions on improvements to increase a more automated workflow
* Guide customers on best practice processes and configuration
* Inform customers about new features and how they can impact their business
* Support clients during test phases and go live of new features
* Interface with peers within the global Professional Services and Customer Success teams

**Qualifications**

* Prior experience of cloud-based/SaaS IT systems
* Prior experience in Spend management, Source-to-Pay/Purchase-to-Pay
* Structured work approach and good communication skills
* The ability to manage several parallel tasks with good quality and control
* Prior experiences of working as a consultant or advisor in accounting

**The following experiences are preferred:**

* Previous experience working with Oracle NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics AX/Finance & Operations, Dynamics NAV/Business Central, or Infor M3
* PowerBI or other reporting tools
* Bachelor of Science or higher degree


The position is full-time and will be based in the Nordics. You must be able to communicate in Swedish and English, both verbally and in writing. Most work is done from your desk, but some travel may be required to client sites.

 **Medius is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.**


Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, experience, qualifications, certifications, internal equity, and the geographic location in which the role is performed. Compensation may vary for roles performed in different locations due to differences in the cost of labor.


The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for variable compensation (such as a performance bonus or commission), benefits, and/or participation in other incentive or benefit plans, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, and retirement benefits, subject to eligibility requirements.

 **Medius is an equal opportunity employer**. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability (physical or mental), genetic information, medical condition, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.


If you require a reasonable accommodation due to a disability or for religious reasons during the application or interview process, please review our accommodations process.

title: Data Scientist Consultant
description:
***Are you a Data Scientist who thrives at the intersection of code, business impact, and applied machine learning?***  

*Do you get energy from solving real-world problems with data, collaborating across teams, and making sure your models drive actual results for clients? Then we’d love to meet you.*

***Why Avaus?***  

We are the leading digital transformation partner for marketing and sales leaders in the Nordics. From B2C to B2B, we work with top-tier brands to unlock value from data and technology. Our mission is to help our clients build the marketing and sales capabilities of the future, spanning AI, personalisation, automation, customer experience orchestration, and modern ways of working.


You’ll join 100 colleagues across Sweden, Finland, Germany and Poland. We have a collaborative, curious, and forward-leaning team united by a passion for data-driven growth.

***The Team***  

At Avaus, you’ll work at the intersection of business, data and technology. Our consultants are trusted advisors and hands-on problem solvers. We turn data into insights, build intelligent solutions, and enable personalised customer experiences — often within complex, multi-cloud environments.


You’ll be surrounded by talented specialists in strategy, analytics, martech, and data engineering — and you’ll be encouraged to constantly learn and grow together.

***The Role***  

As a mid-level data science consultant, your focus is both technical and consultative. You’ll help clients solve real business problems using data — not just by building models, but also by advising on what’s possible, feasible, and impactful.


We see an agentic future, and it is a huge plus if you come with curiosity or experience in agentic workflows (e.g. autonomous agents, orchestration of LLMs/tools, or AI-led decision processes). We’re increasingly building capabilities in this area — and we’re looking for people who want to grow with us.

*You’ll work on:*

* Designing and implementing machine learning models and experiments
* Translating business needs into analytical solutions
* Exploring new data sources and automating analysis
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams across Avaus and client organisations
* Advising on the use of data and AI to drive business outcomes
* Reporting to show-case the results we create for our clients
* Contributing to our asset library within data science, to build our agentic delivery capacity

 ***Who are you?***  

You’re a curious, analytical problem-solver who wants to grow into a trusted advisor. You understand that data science is as much about people, processes and priorities as it is about code. You value impact over elegance — and progress over perfection.

***We believe you have:***

* A Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. engineering, computer science, mathematics)
* Solid knowledge of Python and open-source data science libraries  

Experience with machine learning techniques and experimentation
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and modern data tools (e.g. Looker, Snowflake)
* Comfortable working with SQL and databases
* Experience or interest in recommender systems, agentic workflows, or autonomous AI tools
* Fluent in English and Swedish

 ***Practical Information***


Our office is located at Renstiernas gata 12, and we have a flexible hybrid work model where we both work from our office, the client offices and home sometimes. We’ll agree on the starting data and it is a permanent position with a 6 months probation period. You will report to the Head of Delivery and be in the Data & Analytics competence team.  

  

  



***Apply now***  

Apply through our career page promptly, as interviews will be scheduled continuously. For questions, reach out to Ellen Lübeck, Head of Delivery. Please be aware that email applications cannot be accepted due to GDPR regulations.
